surfaces.name: Domain model
surfaces.summary: Packages, classes, features, operations, enums, datatypes and vocabularies — the structural domain every other surface reads.

surfaces.name: Application design
surfaces.summary: Sculptor-style designs: applications, modules, services, repositories, searches, entity state machines, and executable operation bodies.

surfaces.name: Authorisation
surfaces.summary: Who may do what: actors, delegation, capability grants with typed `when` conditions, obligations, and Cedar policy generation.

surfaces.name: Decision model
surfaces.summary: The decision-requirements graph, business knowledge models, knowledge sources, decision services, and external markdown decision tables.

surfaces.name: Event contract
surfaces.summary: What the system publishes and who reacts: versioned event contracts, channels, and subscriptions with their binding rules.

surfaces.name: Use case pattern
surfaces.summary: SysML-v2-style use case patterns: subjects, actors, messages, successions and `realizes` links.

surfaces.name: Case management
surfaces.summary: CMMN 1.1 case models: case files, discretionary and required plan items, sentries, and decision tasks that invoke sibling decision services.

surfaces.name: Interaction flow
surfaces.summary: Interaction flows over a composed pattern library: views, containers, components, events, navigation, and the declaration-backed control/route manifest.

surfaces.name: Deployment
surfaces.summary: Deployment projections: application components, target capabilities and engines, profiles, settings, and type-checked placement policies.
